title: The fishing net
paragraphs: On the beach before sunrise, Wati noticed a small turtle {{1}} in a fishing net. She knew that pulling {{2}} could hurt it, so she ran to find her uncle. He cut the net with {{3}} movements while she held the turtle still. One of its back legs was badly {{4}}.

They {{5}} it to a rescue centre in the next town. A vet cleaned the wound and said that the turtle had a good {{6}} of recovering. Two months later, Wati returned for its release.
